API ReferenceZscaler Internet Access APIBandwidth Control & ClassesBandwidth Class Resource Add Bandwidth Class
Bandwidth Class Resource Add Bandwidth Class
POST
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/bandwidthClasses

Adds a new bandwidth class. .

Request
​
APPLICATION/JSON
BODY

Information about the bandwidth class

id
int32

System-generated identifier for the bandwidth class

isNameL10nTag
boolean

Indicates whether the bandwidth class name is localized

name
string

Name of the bandwidth class

webApplications
object[]
urls
string[]

The URLs included in the bandwidth class. You can include multiple entries.

applicationServiceGroups
string[]

The application service groups included in the bandwidth class

networkApplications
string[]

The network applications included in the bandwidth class

networkServices
string[]

The network services included in the bandwidth class

urlCategories
object[]
applications
string[]

The applications included in the bandwidth class

Possible values: [ANY, NONE, NETSUITE, DROPBOX, BOXNET, YOUTUBE, METACAFE, HULU, DAILYMOTION, SHOUTCAST, SALESFORCE_1, SKYPE, WEBEX, GOTOMEETING, LIVEMEETING, CONNECT, INTERCALL]

getfileSize
string

The file size for a bandwidth class

Possible values: [ANY, NONE, FILE_5MB, FILE_10MB, FILE_50MB, FILE_100MB, FILE_250MB, FILE_500MB, FILE_1GB]

Responses
​
200
201
401
403

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
id
int32

System-generated identifier for the bandwidth class

isNameL10nTag
boolean

Indicates whether the bandwidth class name is localized

name
string

Name of the bandwidth class

webApplications
object[]
urls
string[]

The URLs included in the bandwidth class. You can include multiple entries.

applicationServiceGroups
string[]

The application service groups included in the bandwidth class

networkApplications
string[]

The network applications included in the bandwidth class

networkServices
string[]

The network services included in the bandwidth class

urlCategories
object[]
applications
string[]

The applications included in the bandwidth class

Possible values: [ANY, NONE, NETSUITE, DROPBOX, BOXNET, YOUTUBE, METACAFE, HULU, DAILYMOTION, SHOUTCAST, SALESFORCE_1, SKYPE, WEBEX, GOTOMEETING, LIVEMEETING, CONNECT, INTERCALL]

getfileSize
string

The file size for a bandwidth class

Possible values: [ANY, NONE, FILE_5MB, FILE_10MB, FILE_50MB, FILE_100MB, FILE_250MB, FILE_500MB, FILE_1GB]

type
string

The application type for which the bandwidth class is configured

Possible values: [ANY, NONE, BANDWIDTH_CAT_WEBCONF, BANDWIDTH_CAT_VOIP, BANDWIDTH_CAT_GENERAL_SURFING, BANDWIDTH_CAT_LARGE_FILE, BANDWIDTH_CAT_SALES, BANDWIDTH_CAT_FINANCE, BANDWIDTH_CAT_MEDIA, BANDWIDTH_CAT_FSHARE]
